<rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7340">spyir bstan pa'i ti ka shes rab <lb n="41b3"/> sgron ma</rs> zhes bya ba mtshan smos par dka' ba'i yul mtha' <choice><sic>ya</sic><corr>yas</corr></choice> chen po <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3818">shag kya'i dge slong brtson 'grus 'bar</rs> gyi gsung dri ma <choice><orig>myed</orig><reg>med</reg></choice> pa'i ro myangs pa dang × | smra ba'i seng ge chen por gyur pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">shag kya'i dge slong chos kyi seng ge</rs> dang × | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3946">shes bya'i naM mkha' la blo gros kyi nyi ma shar ba'i dge slong <choice><orig>gzho</orig><reg>gzhon</reg></choice> nu seng ge</rs> dang × | smra ba'i khyu mchog chen po mi 'jigs <lb n="41b4"/> pa'i spobs pa dang ldan pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6566">shag kya'i dge' slong dha rma sing ha</rs>'i rjes su 'brangs nas × | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3978">shag kya'i dge' slong brtson 'grus grags</rs> kyis sbyar pa || × rdzogs s+h+yo || × || × || × ||</seg></TEI>
